resources.string: ClearTether is free: no time limits, no data caps, no ads.
Office laptop, MacBook, iPhone, iPad, Android, Chromebook: see the easiest way to connect each one, with or without NFC.
Pick the device you want to connect. Every guide uses this phone\'s network name, password and address, so you can follow it as written.
Tip: on any device already joined to the network, open %1$s for one-tap setup.
Guides for every phone, tablet and laptop
Benefits compared with the built-in hotspot
Android Auto, company VPNs, battery and more
Your phone already has a hotspot. Here\'s why ClearTether is often the better choice, and when it isn\'t.
Share even when your phone\'s built-in Hotspot option is missing, greyed out or turned off.
Keep Wi-Fi and Android Auto connected
On most phones the hotspot switches Wi-Fi off. ClearTether\'s Wi-Fi Direct network runs alongside, so your phone can stay on a Wi-Fi network, or on your car\'s wireless Android Auto, while it shares.
Share whatever your phone is using
Mobile data, or a Wi-Fi network your phone has signed in to (a hotel or airport, for example). Your devices get the same connection through your phone.
If a VPN is on, your devices\' traffic goes through it too. The built-in hotspot normally bypasses the VPN.
HTTPS passes through untouched: no certificate warnings, SSL pinning keeps working, and company VPNs that use HTTPS connect normally.
Android devices with ClearTether need no settings at all, and every app works, including games and calls.
The network name and password never change, so devices remember them. Join with a QR code, an NFC tap, or one-tap setup scripts and profiles.
A WPA2-encrypted network for your devices only. Connected devices can\'t reach apps or files on your phone, and you can see how much data each one uses.
No limits, nothing to sign up for. Traffic goes straight from your phone to the internet; ClearTether has no servers in between.
Laptops, iPhones and other non-Android devices need a one-time proxy setting. The setup page and guides do it in a tap or two.
On those devices, apps that ignore the system proxy, online games, ping and IPsec/WireGuard VPNs won\'t work. Android devices running ClearTether don\'t have this limit.
Smart TVs, Chromecast, Xbox and other devices without a proxy setting can\'t connect.
Your phone relays every byte, so long sessions use more battery than the hotspot. Keep it charging.
Use the built-in hotspot instead if it works on your phone and you need games, UDP-based VPNs, or devices without proxy settings.
Can I share while Android Auto is connected?

Wired Android Auto (USB cable): yes. Android Auto uses the cable, ClearTether uses Wi-Fi Direct, and both use your mobile data. Wireless Android Auto: usually yes on recent phones. Your phone talks to the car over Wi-Fi and ClearTether\'s network runs alongside on the same radio channel; ClearTether matches the car\'s channel automatically. Passengers\' heavy downloads share that radio, so if Android Auto stutters or drops, use a USB cable for Android Auto. The car\'s own screen can\'t use ClearTether\'s internet.
How many devices can connect at once?
Usually up to 8, depending on your phone\'s Wi-Fi chip. They can be any mix: laptops, iPhones, tablets and Android phones.
Can devices connect without any setup?

Android devices with ClearTether installed: yes, every app works automatically. Other devices need the one-time proxy setting, because Android doesn\'t let an app route other devices\' traffic without root. The setup page (scan the \"Setup page\" QR code) makes it a tap or two.

No. NFC tap-to-connect is a shortcut between two Android phones. iPhones can\'t join Wi-Fi by NFC; they use the Camera with the QR code. Devices without a camera can type the network name and password shown under the QR code.
Will my company VPN work on my work laptop?

VPNs that connect over HTTPS/TCP usually work: Cisco Secure Client (AnyConnect SSL), GlobalProtect, Zscaler, FortiClient SSL, Ivanti/Pulse. IPsec- or WireGuard-only VPNs can\'t pass through a proxy; ask IT whether an SSL/TCP option is available. ClearTether never decrypts traffic, so security tools see a normal connection.
My laptop or iPhone says \"No internet\". Is something wrong?

Usually not. Some systems check the connection outside the proxy. Browsers and apps that use the system proxy still work. Captive-portal assist (Settings) helps most devices show \"Connected\". If nothing loads, re-check the proxy step in the guide for that device.
Does sharing keep running with the screen off?

Yes. ClearTether runs as a foreground service with a notification. If sharing stops when the screen is off, exempt ClearTether from battery optimization (Settings > Battery optimization), especially on Samsung, Xiaomi, OnePlus and Huawei phones.

Your phone\'s current connection: mobile data, or Wi-Fi if the phone is on Wi-Fi. The Devices card shows how much each device used. Make sure your mobile plan allows using its data on your other devices.

The network uses WPA2 with a random password that you can regenerate anytime (this disconnects every device). ClearTether only accepts devices on its own network, blocks them from reaching your phone\'s own services, never decrypts HTTPS, and has no servers or analytics.
Can my TV, Chromecast or game console use it?

Devices with a manual proxy setting (PlayStation, Nintendo Switch, many Android TV boxes) can: use this phone\'s IP and port from the guide. Chromecast, most smart TVs, Xbox and Roku have no proxy setting, so use the regular hotspot for those.
